summary: Shows or hides the sub-pane at +0x240: caches the flag at +0x42A, on enable calls maybe_Ui_RenkeiWindow_ShowPanes, then toggles the pane through vtable +0x18 and re-splices its node at +0x3F0 when enabling.

name: Ui_Widget_DtorC

name: maybe_Ui_DiveWindow_SetSixLabels
summary: Fills the dive window's label column: writes up to 6 names from the id bytes at self+0x50 through the data-manager lookup 0x0063DED4, pads the remaining rows with an empty string, then writes the position counter and the count into slots 7 and 8.

name: maybe_Ui_TsuyosaWindow_NotifyAndRequestClose

name: Actor_Action_Move_Setup
summary: Prepares the default move action: copies the object's 3D position and direction-dependent offset into the action's start/end records, transforms both through maybe_Gfx_Actor_SetPositionXY, zeroes the velocity accumulators and the state.
evidence: The position copies, the 3-direction offset switch and the named maybe_Gfx_Actor_SetPositionXY transform are all in the body, and the vtable 0x75FCC8 slot +8 is the move action's init slot.

name: Actor_Action_Move_Update
signature: unsigned int Actor_Action_Move_Update(void* self, float dt)
summary: Integrates the move action: advances the action clock and, per state (0/1/2/3), adds the accumulated velocity and acceleration to the scene object's X/Y/Z position; state 1 and the state-2 tail decode to bad instructions.
evidence: The clock increment and the three axis accumulations are explicit and use the fields the confirmed Actor_Action_Move_Setup initialises; the damaged branches only hide which velocity source applies in state 1.

name: maybe_Actor_Action_Move_UpdateAnimation
summary: Per-frame driver of the move action: adds the frame delta to the clock at +0x34 and dispatches the current step of the 4-entry 0x18-byte jump table at +0x2C.
